components.name: Vortex Identity Mark
components.description: The static teal identity used in compact placements; the homepage cycles related paths through the same line treatment.
components.css: .ds-vortex-mark { display: block; width: 72px; height: 72px; overflow: visible; color: var(--teal, #38a3a5); } .ds-vortex-mark path { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet square text navigation for the onyx header.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: var(--muted, #aaa5a8); font-family: "Public Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 570; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--text, #f0edee); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ff6b35); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Featured Reading Sheet
components.description: The primary light-paper entry point into the newest write-up.
components.html: 22 AUG 2026 · 7 MINReading-sheet titleOne restrained sentence describing the note.
components.css: .ds-featured-sheet { display: grid; gap: 22px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper, #f0edee); color: var(--ink, #171419); padding: clamp(34px, 5vw, 58px); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 22px 58px rgba(0,0,0,.32); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-featured-sheet::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 3px; background: var(--teal, #38a3a5); } .ds-featured-sheet strong { font: 650 clamp(2rem,4vw,3.2rem)/1 "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-featured-meta { color: var(--ink-muted, #625b61); font: 10px/1.4 "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-featured-sheet:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 30px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-featured-sheet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ff6b35); outline-offset: 4px; transform: translateY(-6px); }

components.name: Catalogue Entry
components.description: A ruled, full-width writing row that pulls forward without becoming a card.
components.css: .ds-catalog-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 28px; align-items: baseline; position: relative; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #302d31); padding: 30px 20px 32px; color: var(--text, #f0edee); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-catalog-entry time { color: var(--muted, #aaa5a8); font: 10px "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-catalog-entry strong { font: 630 1.35rem/1.25 "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-entry span { color: var(--faint, #807a7f); font: 11px "Public Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-entry:hover { background: var(--room-raised, #131116); transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-catalog-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ff6b35); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A large editorial query field structured by a single teal rule.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label">Search writing<input class="ds-search-field" placeholder="Try static analysis" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--faint, #807a7f); font: 11px "Public Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-search-field { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--teal, #38a3a5); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 0 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f0edee); caret-color: var(--orange, #ff6b35); font: 540 clamp(1.5rem,4vw,2.4rem) "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; outline: none; } .ds-search-field::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder-ink, #817b80); } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: var(--emerald, #57cc99); }

components.name: Topic Tag
components.description: Unboxed hash-prefixed taxonomy kept subordinate to the title.
components.css: .ds-topic-tag { color: var(--faint, #807a7f); background: transparent; font: 570 11px/1.4 "Public Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Copy Action
components.description: A small emerald text action with explicit focus and failure states.
components.css: .ds-copy-action { border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--emerald, #57cc99); font: 570 11px/1.4 "Public Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy-action:hover { color: var(--text, #f0edee); } .ds-copy-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ff6b35); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-copy-action[data-state="error"] { color: var(--orange, #ff6b35); }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: A quiet mint insert for observations inside long-form article paper.
components.html:
Evidence

Record the observable fact before interpreting it.
components.css: .ds-evidence { border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px 20px; background: var(--evidence-mint, #dce9e6); color: var(--ink, #171419); font: 400 16px/1.65 "Public Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-evidence strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--mint-ink, #3e6f68); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 570; } .ds-evidence p { margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Night Reading Room treats the portfolio as a compact onyx interior where platinum paper holds the work worth reading. The voice is quiet, honest, editorial, and beginner-but-promising: credibility comes from clear explanation, visible progress, and care rather than from claims of mastery. The interface keeps room surfaces dark and nearly flat, then introduces physical contrast only where a reading sheet should feel tangible. A hand-drawn teal vortex identifies nomi: it redraws through closely related imperfect paths on the homepage and holds on one static frame elsewhere. Archivo supplies concise editorial authority, Public Sans keeps explanation direct, and Cascadia Code appears only where technical notation benefits.
keyCharacteristics: Onyx room framing platinum reading paper
Hand-drawn teal vortex with one bounded arrival animation
Wide editorial headings paired with plain, readable prose
Flat tonal hierarchy with selective physical paper lift
Fine one-pixel rules and square interaction controls
Sparse mineral accents with fixed semantic jobs

rules.name: The Mineral Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal guides, emerald confirms, and orange focuses or warns; never distribute all three as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Paper Contrast Rule
rules.body: Light neutrals belong to reading sheets and information inserts; the surrounding site chrome stays in room tones.

rules.name: The Short Display Rule
rules.body: Keep Archivo display lines compact and deliberately short; explanation belongs in Public Sans below, not in six-line headings.

rules.name: The Wide Room, Narrow Page Rule
rules.body: Let the room feel spacious, but constrain explanation to readable measures and collapse structure before type becomes cramped.

rules.name: The Flat Room Rule
rules.body: Do not shadow ordinary navigation, catalogue rows, controls, or tonal inserts; elevation belongs only to paper and temporary overlay layers.

rules.name: The Sheet Geometry Rule
rules.body: Reserve rounded corners for surfaces that read as sheets or contained technical inserts; interactive chrome remains square.

rules.name: The Vortex Identity Rule
rules.body: Redrawing belongs only to the homepage arrival mark. Every identity placement uses the exact Edge Teal token at full opacity; compact marks share one static path, round caps, and no decorative container.

rules.name: The Restrained Response Rule
rules.body: State changes may lift a reading sheet, pull a catalogue row, redraw the homepage identity, or shift text color; do not combine those responses on ordinary controls.

dos: Do keep dark room chrome flat and separate regions with one-pixel Room Line rules.
Do use Platinum Paper for primary reading surfaces and 14px corners only while those surfaces remain inset.
Do reserve the 2px Orange Focus outline with a 4px offset for visible keyboard focus.
Do hold long-form article copy to 17px, 1.82 line-height, and a 70ch maximum.
Do preserve the 900px, 720px, and 520px responsive transformations when extending the surface.
Do reduce transitions to effectively zero when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
Do keep the animated vortex visible by default, pause it offscreen or in background tabs, and hold one static frame for reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce terminal-blog chrome, tactical dashboards, status telemetry, or exaggerated expertise cues.
Don't turn the reading-room metaphor into literal shelves, lamps, paper textures, or vintage decoration.
Don't add rounded pills, floating glass panels, gradients, or generic card stacks.
Don't spread teal, emerald, and orange evenly across a screen; each accent has a fixed job.
Don't shadow ordinary rows, controls, or mint inserts.
Don't let responsive compression narrow the reading measure by shrinking body text.
Don't rotate, glow, continuously distort, or independently redraw compact vortex marks.
